status_note: Cross-form gates, exclusions, reversal rules and generic field rules. Rules marked PROPOSAL are design choices, not BIR text.

rules.formula: The BIR app writes this box or derives it. Books never sends it and never reads it as an input.
Online username, secret and confirmation fields. Books never stores, reads or sends values for these keys.
rules.status_detail: Keys are named here; no value is ever recorded.

rules.formula: Page-2 copies of the TIN, branch code and name. The app derives them. Books never sends them.
A person signs or declares. Books never signs, auto-fills or submits this.
Schema key with no field-tab row. Not fillable by Books.
rules.status_detail: No crosswalk entry should use this id; it marks an unmapped schema key.

rules.formula: The BIR taxpayer profile supplies the value. Forms refuses a fill while the profile holds it. Books never sends profile values.
Block the 8% option and the percentage-tax return when posted sales year-to-date are strictly above 3,000,000.00 (3000000.00 pesos, decimal text). Force VAT status after that date.
rules.status_detail: The CPI-adjusted figure is UNKNOWN (bir.md PT-7). The threshold is a dated fact in rates-v1.json.

rules.formula: In a taxable year with a valid 8% election, produce no 2551Q values (block, no NIL row in MVP).
rules.status_detail: CONFLICT CONFIRMED (verify.md s2 #73, #84). Resolution needs RR 8-2018 full text, which was not read (blocker B5, decision D5). Do not choose a side in code until resolved.
citations: RMO 23-2018 pt 9(a)-(e) (bir.md 8-6; verify.md s2 #73: 8% electors do not file 2551Q)

rules.formula: A sales return, allowance or credit note posted in the quarter blocks the 2551Q proposal until a person acknowledges it. Regenerating after acknowledgement creates a new proposal row.
rules.status_detail: The gate is a PROPOSAL (decision D20). The 2551Q treatment of credit notes is UNCONFIRMED.
citations: bir.md PT-8 (no printed deduction for returns; UNVERIFIED)
verify.md: credit-note treatment not verified (bir.md PT-8)

rules.formula: Mixed earners (compensation plus business) get no 250,000 reduction on the 8% component.
Show a return as overdue after its due date. Compute no surcharge or interest (decision D14).
citations: workbook 2551Q fields II.23 'Do not invent penalties'

rules.formula: A closed tax period is immutable. Reopen needs a reason, writes a period_event and marks dependent proposals stale.
citations: books.md s1 #9 (org-wide lock; tax filing ignores it)

rules.formula: A proposal is stale when a line revision, tax fact, rule set, rate row, schema hash or period reopen changes. Stale proposals are refused for fill.
Only certificates with status 'received' create a credit. Pending, lost and disputed certificates never credit. WB084 (final) is never credited.
citations: books.md s4g (postCwtReceivable does not check status; PARTIAL defect)

rules.formula: Employer contributions never go to 1601-C item 19. Item 19 takes the employee share only.
Income-tax 2307 lines (WI/WC series) never feed 2551Q item 15 (percentage tax).
citations: bir.md W-3 (routing by series; INFERENCE from form headings)
workbook 2551Q field II.15 'Must not mix with income-tax 2307'

rules.formula: Percentage-tax 2307 lines (WB series) never feed 1701-MS income-tax credits (V.3, V.4, V.5).
citations: workbook 1701-MS field V.4 'Do not use percentage tax withheld'

rules.formula: WB084 (final withholding, Section 116 applies) is never credited against 2551Q or 1701-MS. It belongs to 2306.
Pending, lost or disputed certificates create no credit. They post to no control account.
citations: books.md s4g (defect: postCwtReceivable does not check status)

rules.formula: Output VAT is excluded from the gross sales base for non-VAT filers and from 1701-MS IV.5.
citations: bir.md M-3 (gross sales net of VAT)

rules.formula: Bank deposits and collections are not sales. Use invoices and posted sales lines.
citations: workbook 1701-MS IV.5 'Do not use gross bank deposits'

rules.formula: Interest income subject to final tax is excluded from the graduated and 8% other-income lines. It is shown separately.
rules.status_detail: Whether Books stores a final-tax attribute is UNKNOWN (sheets.md s10). Do not apply until the attribute exists.

rules.formula: Spouse (B-side) fields are refused in MVP.
The return tax is computed from the ATC base, not from the payable balance or the ledger's VAT accounts.
A void in an open tax period posts a reversal entry dated the original entry date. The period totals then net to zero.
rules.status_detail: PROPOSAL and INFERENCE (design correction A4). Without the original-date reversal, Q3 gross would stay at 300,000.00.

rules.formula: A reversal dated in a later, closed period is a return event. It blocks the affected proposal until acknowledged.
rules.status_detail: PROPOSAL (journey s7.5). Tax treatment of credit notes is UNCONFIRMED for 2551Q (bir.md PT-8).

rules.formula: A credit note is a document kind. It links to the original sale and blocks the 2551Q until acknowledged.
citations: workbook Category field rules row 15 ('Confirm recognition and credit note')

rules.formula: A sales adjustment is counted once: on the 2551Q base or on 1701-MS IV.6 and IV.19, never both in the same form line.
citations: workbook Category field rules row 17 ('Same adjustment must not be counted twice')

rules.formula: 2551Q applies to Section 116 persons (non-VAT, percentage tax). Other percentage-tax ATCs need their own schedule row.
1701-MS is for micro and small individuals. Tier by taxable-year gross sales: micro below 3,000,000.00; small from 3,000,000.00 to below 20,000,000.00 (net of VAT, business income only).
citations: lawphil numerals are off by 1,000 (verify.md s2 #71); the words govern

rules.formula: A trust or estate in trade or business is in scope for 1701-MS in the cases named in RMC 34-2025 Annex A item 3.
rules.status_detail: The workbook label 'Individual/Fiduciary' stays. Annex C text is TY2025 only (verify.md s2 #80).
citations: RMC 34-2025 Annex A item 3 (verify.md s2 #60, REFUTED as 'Individual' only)

rules.formula: A certificate of registration or a form list does not choose the method. Do not infer 8%, OSD, itemized, payroll or one-time events from a COR.
RMC 20-2026 Annex C is the TY2025 FAQ. Its applicability to TY2026 is UNKNOWN.
